lines.hook: Pau Cubarsí has won the Kopa Trophy. Our ballot had him first.
stats: Eight World Cup starts: every minute of Spain's title, the final included.
Spain conceded once in the whole tournament.
Eighty-six on his EA FC twenty-seven card.

lines.quote: Yamal was the favourite for the Kopa. Cubarsí had already won the World Cup's version of it, and now he has both.
